answer: A newcomer should not be able to wander straight into high-value deals. Require every new agent to collect endorsements from several established, unrelated peers who stake their own standing on the newcomer, and cap how many newcomers each peer may vouch for per epoch. Trust then moves at a glacier's pace and cannot be mass-produced: forging one identity is easy, forging a whole web of independent backers is not, and a copper-cheap flood of fakes starves without endorsements.
